train_video_model: run the train function to train a video classification model for multiple epochs with evaluation
train_one_epoch: run train_epoch to perform one epoch of video training with gradient accumulation and mixup support
evaluate_model: run eval_epoch to evaluate the video model on a validation set and log top1 and top5 errors
build_trainer: call build_trainer to construct the model, optimizer, data loaders, and meters from a config
update_bn_stats: call calculate_and_update_precise_bn to update batch normalization statistics using precise stats from training data
